test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states are 'Husori' or 'Huchari' performance associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first-ever Bihu "Husori troupe"** is stealing the show in Dibrugarh's Moran area since this is the first time young girls will be playing the **Dhol, Pepa, Gagana, and Taal, which are typically played by men when performing Husori.**
 
• The only Husori Troupe for girls in Assam and the first. Husori is typically performed by boys, however, girls can also do it.
 
• **Lahori is also performed by boys.**
 
• A crucial component of **Rongali Bihu, "Husori" is sung on Cow Bihu, the first day of the festival.**
 
• On this day, young men sing a Bihu song called "Husori" door to door while being guided by the elders. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
